name: productops-jira
description: Audit Jira sprints: health score, cycle time, blockers, scope creep and carry-over. Read-only, with demo data.
long_description: Read-only MCP server for Jira sprint health. Metrics are computed by code and every finding cites the issues behind it. Starts with a synthetic demo team, so it works without a Jira account. For your own Jira Cloud, run `npx -y @productops-mcp/jira login` once in a terminal and set the mode to live; it reads Jira through the official Atlassian MCP server.
